entities.summary: Ekinlik Island, formerly Koutalis is an island situated off the Turkish coast, in the Sea of Marmara. Administratively, the island belongs to Marmara, the central settlement of Marmara Island in Balikesir, Turkey. The island has an area of approximately 2.47 square kilometres, one village with the same name, and a population of 102, according to the 2014 census.
